caseName: Train v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc.
caseNameFull: Train, Administrator, Environmental Protection Agency v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc.

opinions.text:
Application for stay of Part III of order of the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit presented to Mr. Justice Powell, and by him referred to the Court, granted pending final disposition of petition for writ of certiorari.

Mr. Justice Douglas dissents from granting stay.
